title: Cosmic Tree of Worlds
description: A surreal cosmic entity stands within a glowing golden rectangular frame, half mechanical armored figure with crystalline spikes and half translucent female form filled with stars and nebulae. Massive dark tree roots spread from the base across a futuristic cityscape below, with aurora borealis lighting the dark sky above.
